items.before: Before, the country of origin box had the hint 'Start typing to search for a country.' Now there is no hint, and with JavaScript the empty box shows 'Search for a country'. Without JavaScript it is still a dropdown that starts with 'Select a country'. The plants origin page makes the same change and keeps its own country list, guidance and errors.
items.after:
Before, the country of origin box had the hint 'Start typing to search for a country.'

Now:
- there is no hint
- with JavaScript, the empty box shows 'Search for a country'
- without JavaScript, it is still a dropdown that starts with 'Select a country'

The plants origin page makes the same change.

The plants page keeps its own country list, guidance and errors.

items.before: Country of origin: no hint and a 'Search for a country' placeholder, in animals and plants
items.after: Country of origin: no hint, and the empty box shows 'Search for a country', in animals and plants

items.before: Before, places such as the Canary Islands appeared in the country of origin list under their own name only. Now each one shows its country in brackets, and the list is sorted by the name shown. Choosing one still saves the same code. Which places are listed is still whatever the master reference data (MDM) serves.
items.after:
Before, places such as the Canary Islands appeared in the country of origin list under their own name only.

Now:
- each one shows its country in brackets
- the list is sorted by the name shown

Choosing one still saves the same code.

Which places are listed is still whatever the master reference data (MDM) serves.

items.before: Country of origin list labels subdivisions with their parent country
items.after: Country of origin list shows places within a country with their country in brackets

items.before: The region of origin code hint now reads 'Check the health certificate for a region of origin code. You can add the code later if you do not have the certificate now.' The internal reference hint no longer says 'It can be up to 58 characters.'; a longer reference is still refused with an error that names the limit.
items.after:
The region of origin code hint now reads:

'Check the health certificate for a region of origin code. You can add the code later if you do not have the certificate now.'

The internal reference hint no longer says 'It can be up to 58 characters.'

A longer reference is still refused, with an error that names the limit.

items.before: The region code box now stops typing at 5 characters. Changing a saved 'Yes' to 'No' clears the code, so the review shows 'Not applicable' and choosing Yes again shows an empty box. A code typed before a country is chosen stays on the page but is not saved until a country gives it its prefix. The country prefix is still added after saving; showing it live as the country is picked waits on design.
items.after:
The region code box now stops typing at 5 characters.

Changing a saved 'Yes' to 'No' clears the code. So:
- the review shows 'Not applicable'
- choosing Yes again shows an empty box

A code typed before a country is chosen stays on the page.

It is not saved until a country gives it its prefix.

The country prefix is still added after saving.

Showing the prefix live as the country is picked waits on design.

items.before: Before, the origin task could show Complete with only a country. Now it needs the country and an answer to the region of origin code question, plus a code when the answer is Yes.
items.after:
Before, the origin task could show Complete with only a country.

Now it needs:
- the country
- an answer to the region of origin code question
- a code, when the answer is Yes
